# compare-race

> Same prompt, several models -- stopwatch or true race; the starting model judges.
> Last-checked: 2026-09-05 | Version: 0.6.0 | Tests: 27 passed | Lint: ruff clean

## Core idea

Fan one prompt out to N models (sequential = stopwatch, clean per-lane timing;
parallel = true race), optional repeats per model, collect artefacts, and let the
STARTING model write the verdict. Time is only ONE dimension: the judge rubric carries
quality, correctness, completeness, instruction fidelity, latency, cost.

## Identity (reused from system-auditor)

Six axes per run: time, prompt (slug+hash), system, model, run, variant. Attribute
only when exactly one axis varies: model->race, run->variance, time->model drift,
variant->twin/clone comparison. Artefact headers parse with
system_auditor.report.parse_front_matter (hard dependency).

## Execution

COMA (spawn/file protocol/polling) is detected, not assumed: adapters claude/codex/
agy/kimi, per-lane model override. Without COMA: model-manual path via
`compare-race record`. Failed lanes are recorded (ok: false), never hidden. Optional
`lane_workdir` isolates inherited working directories on Python 3.10+, while raw
per-lane process logs are persisted below `_lane-logs` when `races_dir` is set.

## Entry points

- prompts/RACE-STARTER.de.md + .en.md   role prompt (starter = judge by default)
- config/compare-race.config.example.json
- CLI: compare-race config|plan|run|record|report|olympiade (+ run --twin)
- src/compare_race/: tokens, config, race, report, costs, cli

## Neighbours (optional)

coma (execution) · clutch (model catalogue) · swarm-ai (mechanical N-repeat
consensus) · MarbleRun (sequential chains). compare-race adds the qualitative judge
over sibling outputs and the repeats x models cross product.
